zones.description: Residential quarters with wind-protected courtyards and perimeter blocks are positioned outside flood-prone shoreline areas while maintaining visual access toward the Moskva River.
Higher-density mixed-use development along the Marc Chagall embankment combines housing, grocery stores, cafés, and active public ground floors facing the waterfront.
Office campuses, coworking spaces, research centers, and technology hubs are concentrated near transport corridors and metro accessibility points.
Historic red-brick factory buildings are preserved and adapted into museums, galleries, educational venues, workshops, and creative industry spaces.
Expansion of the Ice Palace and adjacent sports facilities with arenas, recreation halls, cinemas, and event spaces strengthens the district's public identity.
Schools, multiple kindergartens, clinics, libraries, and community centers are distributed within walking distance of residential neighborhoods.

zones.purpose: Tyufeleva Roshcha park extension and ecological corridors
zones.description: Large-scale parks, green corridors, and stormwater landscapes extend Tyufeleva Roshcha Park and reduce wind exposure through vegetation belts and terrain modeling.
Continuous public embankment with promenades, cycling routes, piers, terraces, and water recreation zones preserves full public access to the 6 km shoreline.
Transport interchanges, structured parking, logistics access, and landscaped acoustic barriers mitigate noise from the Third Ring Road and railway.
Public river transport facilities, marina services, electric boat piers, and recreational boating infrastructure integrate with the South River Terminal.

facts: Maximum building height does not exceed 15 floors.
Green and public open spaces significantly exceed the minimum requirement of 15% of the territory.
Residential development is excluded from flood risk zones near the riverfront.
Visual corridors toward the Moskva River are preserved through stepped building heights and open public spaces.
Noise mitigation measures are concentrated along the Third Ring Road and western railway edge.
At least one kindergarten and grocery stores are provided within walking distance of all residential quarters.
Tyufeleva Roshcha Park is integrated into a larger ecological and recreational network across the peninsula.
Historic industrial buildings are preserved and adaptively reused as cultural and creative facilities.
Wind mitigation is achieved through vegetation belts, block orientation, and protected courtyards.
The embankment and shoreline remain publicly accessible with continuous pedestrian and cycling routes.
The redevelopment integrates with MCC station ZIL, Tekhnopark metro station, future metro infrastructure, and river transport.
